root.name: Latvian Gambit: Behting Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 f5 3. Bc4 fxe4 4. Nxe5 Qg5 5. Nf7 Qxg2 6. Rf1 d5 7. Nxh8 Nf6

overview: Both sides play an almost forced tactical sequence: ...Qg5, Nf7 Qxg2, Rf1 d5 and Nxh8 Nf6. White has two pawns plus a rook for them, while Black has the queen on g2 and pieces ready. The game goes on to a messy attack and counter-attack.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the material and consolidate, then play Bxd5 and Qh5
Use Nxh8 and the open f-file

black_ideas.idea: Use the queen and initiative on g2 to attack the king

typical_structures.structure: Open position with wide king exposure on both sides

character.notes: Forcing tactics from move three. Highly forcing.

approach.notes: The Latvian is seldom played at all.

level.notes: Dubious lines are not Beginner; forcing theory is needed.
